title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Long Island Community Hospital Amphitheater, Farmingville | 2019
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Long Island Community Hospital Amphitheater in Farmingville, New York, USA, on 17 August 2019.

It was the 24th show of the 14th All-Starr Band’s tour of Asia and North America, which lasted for 34 dates between March and September 2019.

The 14th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, piano
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar, harmonica
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet

  • ‘Give Peace A Chance’
